description: Traces water through evaporation, clouds, plants, soils, streams and aquifers, explaining discharge versus water age, transit and storage timescales, isotope tracers, GRACE gravity observations and hydrological budgets.

related_resources.reason: Storage versus flow; evaporation, precipitation, transpiration, infiltration, runoff and human influence.
Present-day energy flows; feedbacks including water vapor, cloud, ice and radiative forcing; uncertainty and ocean heat uptake.
Global humidity response, precipitation energy constraints, water cycle variability and global versus regional patterns.
Gaining and losing streams; hydraulic gradients, shallow groundwater and flow effects of pumping.
Hydrogen and oxygen isotopes, tritium, radon and chemical tracers for residence, origin and flow pathways.
GRACE twin-satellite gravity measurement and its relationship to water-storage changes.
GRACE spatial averaging limits and separation from local aquifer behavior; complementarity with InSAR.
